# Composition change data {.unnumbered}

## Formula for the contribution of fluxes

The contribution of a given flux (recruitment, growth or mortality) at time $t$ can be written as:

$$CF_{F,t} = \sum_{i\in F_t}\frac{ba_{i,t}  (ft_{i} - CWM_{t0})}{BA_{t}}-\sum_{i\in F_t}\frac{ba_{i,t0} (ft_{i} - CWM_{t0})}{BA_{t0}}$$

where $F_t$ is the set of trees contributing to a given flux between $t-1$ and $t$ (recruitment: trees recruited at $t$; growth: trees that were measured and alive at $t$ and $t-1$; mortality: trees that died between $t-1$ and $t$).

$ba_{i,t}$ is the basal area of a tree $i$ at time $t$; $ft_{i}$ is the functional trait value of tree $i$; $BA_t$ is the basal area of the entire community at $t$; $CWM_t$ is the community weighted mean trait value at $t$.

We subtract $CWM_{t-1}$ to have negative contributions when the flux decreases the CWM between $t-1$ and $t$; and positive contributions that increase the $CWM$.

As written, the contributions are additive:

$$CWM_t= CWM_{t-1} + CF_{G,t} + CF_{R,t}+CF_{M,t}$$

## Data

```{r}
plot_info <- read.csv("data/raw_data/bioforest-plot-information.csv") |>
  select(site, plot, Year_of_harvest, Treatment)
data_ba <- read.csv("data/derived_data/aggregated_data_v10.csv") |>
  filter(grepl("badiff", variable)) |>
  separate(variable, c(NA, "cohort", "flux"), sep = "_") |>
  rename(diffba = value)
data_ba_all <- data_ba |>
  group_by(Site, Plot, Year) |>
  summarise(
    diffba = sum(diffba), cohort = "all",
    flux = "all", .groups = "drop"
  )
data <- read.csv("data/derived_data/aggregated_data_v10.csv") |>
  filter(grepl("cwmdiff", variable)) |>
  left_join(plot_info, by = join_by(Site == site, Plot == plot)) |>
  separate(variable, c("trait", NA, "cohort", "flux"), sep = "_") |>
  mutate(flux = ifelse(is.na(flux), "all", flux)) |>
  left_join(bind_rows(data_ba, data_ba_all)) |>
  mutate(t0 = case_when(
    Site == "Paracou" & cohort == "s" ~ 1990,
    Site == "Paracou" & cohort != "s" ~ 1987,
    Site == "Mbaiki" & cohort == "s" ~ 1989,
    Site == "Mbaiki" & cohort != "s" ~ 1986,
    Site == "SUAS" ~ 1993
  )) |>
  filter(Year >= t0)
```

### Annual changes

::: panel-tabset
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig.height: 7
#| fig.width: 10

sites <- c("Paracou", "Mbaiki", "SUAS")
labs_flux <- c(
  all = "Change in CWM",
  rba = "Contribution of recruitment",
  gba = "Contribution of growth",
  mba = "Contribution of mortality"
)
purrr::walk(
  sites,
  \(s) {
    cat("#### ", s, "\n\n")
    print(
      data |>
        filter(Site == s) |>
        group_by(Plot, Treatment, Year, trait, flux) |>
        summarise(value = sum(value)) |>
        ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = value, group = Plot, col = Treatment)) +
        geom_line() +
        geom_point() +
        facet_grid(trait ~ flux,
          scales = "free",
          labeller = labeller(flux = labs_flux)
        ) +
        labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
        theme_minimal()
    )
    cat("\n\n")
  }
)
```
:::

### Cumulative changes

::: panel-tabset
```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig.height: 7
#| fig.width: 10

sites <- c("Paracou", "Mbaiki", "SUAS")
labs_flux <- c(
  all = "Change in CWM",
  rba = "Contribution of recruitment",
  gba = "Contribution of growth",
  mba = "Contribution of mortality"
)
purrr::walk(
  sites,
  \(s) {
    cat("#### ", s, "\n\n")
    print(
      data |>
        filter(Site == s) |>
        group_by(Plot, Treatment, Year, trait, flux) |>
        summarise(value = sum(value)) |>
        arrange(Plot, Year) |>
        group_by(Plot, trait, flux) |>
        mutate(value = cumsum(value)) |>
        ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = value, group = Plot, col = Treatment)) +
        geom_line() +
        geom_point() +
        facet_grid(trait ~ flux,
          scales = "free",
          labeller = labeller(flux = labs_flux)
        ) +
        labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
        theme_minimal()
    )
    cat("\n\n")
  }
)
```

### Contribution to CWM change vs BA change

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig.height: 12
#| fig.width: 12
sites <- c("Paracou", "Mbaiki", "SUAS")
data_cwm0 <- read.csv("data/derived_data/aggregated_data_v10.csv") |>
  filter(grepl("_cwm_ba$|^ba$", variable) & Site %in% sites) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "variable") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("cwm")) |>
  mutate(trait = gsub("_cwm_ba$", "", name)) |>
  select(-name) |>
  mutate(Plot = gsub("_[0-9]+", "", Plot)) |>
  group_by(Site, Plot, trait, Year) |>
  summarise(cwm = weighted.mean(value, ba), ba = mean(ba)) |>
  group_by(Site, Plot, trait) |>
  summarise(cwm = cwm[Year == min(Year)], ba = ba[Year == min(Year)])
gmain <- data |>
  filter(cohort != "all") |>
  mutate(group = paste(cohort, flux, sep = "_")) |>
  left_join(data.frame(lab = labs_flux, group = names(labs_flux))) |>
  left_join(data_cwm0) |>
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Plot, trait, group = lab, Year) |>
  summarise(value = sum(value / cwm) * 100, diffba = sum(diffba / ba) * 100) |>
  group_by(Site, Plot, trait, group) |>
  arrange(Year) |>
  mutate(valuec = cumsum(value), diffbac = cumsum(diffba)) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = diffbac, y = valuec,
    group = paste(Plot, group), col = paste(group, Treatment)
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey") +
  geom_path() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(trait ~ Site, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(10, "Paired")
                     [c(1:4, 9:10, 7:8, 5:6)]) +
  labs(
    x = "Cumulative change in BA (% of initial BA)", col = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative contribution to CWM change (% of initial CWM)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid = element_blank())

legend <- data.frame(
  treat = rep(c("Logging", "Control"), 5),
  flux = rep(c("Recruitment", "Growth", "Mortality", "Growth", "Mortality"),
    each = 2
  ),
  cohort = c(rep("Recruits", 6), rep("Survivors", 4))
) |>
  mutate(x = (treat == "Logging") * 0.25 + (cohort == "Survivors") * 0.5) |>
  ggplot(aes(x, flux)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = paste(flux, cohort, treat)), size = 5) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 0.125, y = 3.5, label = "Recruits") +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 0.625, y = 3.5, label = "Survivors") +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 0, y = 0.5, label = "Control", size = 3) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 0.25, y = 0.5, label = "Logging", size = 3) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Control", size = 3) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 0.75, y = 0.5, label = "Logging", size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(10, "Paired")
                      [c(3:4, 7:8, 9:10, 5:6, 1:2)]) +
  geom_segment(x = 0.375, y = 0.6, yend = 3.2) +
  geom_segment(x = 0.125, y = 0.6, yend = 3.2, lty = 2) +
  geom_segment(x = 0.625, y = 0.6, yend = 3.2, lty = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  lims(x = c(-0.1, 0.8)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  )
ggpubr::ggarrange(gmain, ggpubr::ggarrange(NULL, legend, NULL, nrow = 1),
  nrow = 2, heights = c(5, 1)
)
ggsave("paper_cwm/figures/flux_cwm.png", height = 10, width = 8)
```

### Contribution to CWM change vs BA change - by cohort

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig.height: 10
#| fig.width: 8

gmain <- data |>
  mutate(group = case_when(
    cohort == "n" ~ "Recruits",
    cohort == "s" ~ "Survivors"
  )) |>
  filter(cohort != "all") |>
  left_join(data_cwm0) |>
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Plot, trait, group, Year) |>
  summarise(value = sum(value / cwm) * 100, diffba = sum(diffba / ba) * 100) |>
  group_by(Site, Plot, trait, group) |>
  arrange(Year) |>
  mutate(valuec = cumsum(value), diffbac = cumsum(diffba)) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = diffbac, y = valuec,
    group = paste(Plot, group), col = paste(group, Treatment)
  )) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(trait ~ Site, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(10, "Paired")
                     [c(1:2, 5:6)]) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Cumulative change in BA (% of initial BA)", col = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative contribution to CWM change (% of initial CWM)"
  )
legend <- data.frame(
  treat = rep(c("Logging", "Control"), 2),
  cohort = c(rep("Recruits", 2), rep("Survivors", 2))
) |>
  ggplot(aes(cohort, treat)) +
  geom_point(aes(col = paste(cohort, treat)), size = 5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(10, "Paired")
                      [c(1:2, 5:6)]) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid = element_blank())
ggpubr::ggarrange(gmain, ggpubr::ggarrange(NULL, legend, NULL, nrow = 1),
  nrow = 2, heights = c(6, 1)
)
ggsave("paper_cwm/figures/cohort_cwm.png")
```
